d: Crumbling cut banks, collapsing berms, and multi-ton excavators sinking into bottomless permafrost slurry. When heavy iron goes down on a gold claim, production halts instantly and costs skyrocket by the minute. Watch operators scramble against time to stabilize massive rolling machines, cut through seized bearings with blowtorches, and rig emergency haul lines before massive structural collapses occur. This action-packed showcase captures the raw brute force, tense near-misses, and desperate salvage operations required to keep the hunt for gold alive in the unforgiving north.
